messages:
emma: Heads-up — ACME (enterprise) opened a ticket: sudden drop in semantic-search quality after Monday's model swap. Seeing top-1 mismatch on customer golden queries :eyes:

sophie: saw it in Support. They sent sample queries + expected vs actual. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-1234 — mismatch rate ~15% on a 2k sample.

raj: can you paste an example query and the model tag? Need to know if this was a runtime change or a model artifact.

sophie: model changed from `embed-service:v1.4.2` -> `v1.5.0`. Example: "how to reset password" expected doc id=42, got id=7. Log snippet: ```query_id: q-993, expected_top: [42], actual_top: [7], top_scores: [0.22, 0.21, 0.19]```

lucy: preliminary look: v1.5.0 included a new quantization pipeline tweak that could shift neighbors. I'll run batch cosine comparisons across 500 golden pairs — give me ~1h.

emma: OK. Customer is P1 (SLA). Options: rollback model routing, ship re-quantize hotfix, or tweak retrieval threshold. Which buy time fastest?

raj: rollback is fastest operationally. I can route them back to v1.4.2; need oncall approval for routing change.

eng-oncall-bot: @oncall-sre paging — routing change request for ACME rollback.

oncall-sre: I can do routing rollback. Send model tag + target cluster, and I'll execute. Note I'll run a 5% canary first.

lucy: I'll keep working on re-quantize candidate in parallel; estimate ~4h to produce and run regression tests.

sophie: customer explicitly requested rollback ASAP, they accept a temporary rollback while you investigate.

emma: decision: rollback now to stop customer impact. Lucy will pursue re-quantize fix in parallel and we will schedule a postmortem. Raj, coordinate the rollback and document steps.

raj: starting rollback. Pasting commands and checks as I run them.

raj: ```# canary rollback to v1.4.2
kubectl set image deploy/embedding-service embedding=redwood/embedding:v1.4.2 --record
# verify pods
kubectl rollout status deploy/embedding-service
# monitor metrics: ./scripts/monitor-embed.sh acme-tenant
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 5% nodes for embedding-service (tag: v1.4.2). Monitoring active.

raj: Canary looks good for 10m (no spike in latency, match rates improving). Promoting to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete. All nodes running redwood/embedding:v1.4.2.

sophie: customer confirmed search results back to expected baseline :tada: — they've acknowledged the rollback.

emma: owners/actions: postmortem & RCA = lucy, rollback runbook + infra notes = raj, customer comms = sophie. I'll open an epic to track re-quantize PR + model gating for future swaps.

lucy: will upload similarity matrix and regression tests to #eng-ml and link the PR when ready.

emma: thanks all for the quick loop. Closing this thread; follow-up epic will include: stricter model-change canary metrics, embedding regression suite, and an automated rollback playbook. :white_check_mark:
